answers.finding: No U.S. label for afatinib found in searched database; no mention of trichomegaly or eyelash growth in any section.
U.S. label sections reviewed (Lenvima v82, effective 2026-10-14) include renal failure/impairment in dosage modifications and warnings but do not mention tumour lysis syndrome.

U.S. label (Poteligeo v21) lists 'Immune-mediated colitis' in Section 6.2 Postmarketing Experience; a search of the label for colitis terms (colitis, ulcerative colitis, microscopic colitis, ischemic colitis, infectious colitis, drug-induced colitis, enterocolitis, typhlitis) found matches only in Section 6.2, not in Warnings and Precautions or Boxed Warning.
US label v36 (effective 2026-02-09) includes hyperammonemic encephalopathy in section 5.1 Hepatotoxicity with warning to withhold and consider discontinuation if confirmed.
Zoloft v7 (2025-07-24) contains no mention of MADD in any section.
US label (Bactrim) includes circulatory shock in WARNINGS (Hypersensitivity and Other Serious or Fatal Reactions) and ADVERSE REACTIONS sections.
US label (v23, 2026-08-06) lists colitis under diarrhea in Adverse Reactions (section 6.1) but does not mention immune-mediated enterocolitis or immune effector cell-associated enteritis.
No U.S. label version of brodalumab found in label table; search for pyoderma gangrenosum terms matched 0 sections.
US label (v24, effective 2026-07-28) includes digoxin immunoassay interference warning in Warnings and Precautions (5.8) and Drug Interactions (7.3).
US label (v18, March 2025) lists hallucinations only as a symptom of serotonin syndrome (Section 5.2), not as a separate adverse reaction unrelated to serotonin syndrome.
